text:
Ava Patel: Quick leadership note for the week — short and practical. 1) Status: Private GA checklist is largely green but two blockers (EU KMS audit + Dedicated autoscale stability). 2) Metrics highlights: p99 gen latency on hosted down to ~180ms (W/W -12%), token cost per 1k down ~9% due to batching/quant configs, error rate steady at 0.6% across routes. 3) Top asks: @Sofia finalize fallback/runbook by Wed, @Jonah confirm Reserved capacity for top-5 customers by EOD Thu, @Priya prep GA comms & post-beta docs. I’ll join the EU KMS call Tue 9am PT. :rocket:

Liam Chen: Thanks Ava — aligning roadmap shift now. We’ll pull one product PM (Emily) onto GA work to unblock docs/SDK checklists. Expect a small alpha release for function-calling fixes by Friday. :+1:

Sofia Reyes: Quick infra update — KV-cache PR merged, smoke tests good. Observed p50->p99 improvements after change. Open: autoscale flapping on burst traffic (repro steps in #eng-infra). Working on a conservative cooldown policy this afternoon.

Jonah Kim: Reserved slots request submitted to finance & capacity planning. Estimated incremental spend ~ $80k/month to meet SLAs for the five accounts flagged by @Priya. Queue link: https://internal.redwood/inventory/req/4521. Will confirm allocation once finance signs off.

Priya Nair: Customer success roundup — three beta customers (Novus, DeepWell, AtlasHealth) flagged as priority for GA comms. Draft GA email + rollout calendar in drive: https://drive.redwood/ga-rollout/draft. Recommend soft-launch week-of Apr 7 for EU customers after KMS sign-off.

Allison (People Ops): Heads up — hiring exception approved for one senior infra engineer; backfill interviews scheduled Fri. Also rolling comp calibration next Thu — execs please review comp docs in Lattice before Wed COB.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: service/redwood-runtime deployed to prod at 1723456850 — release 2.9.4 :white_check_mark: (no errors).

Sofia Reyes: Adding the runbook checklist snippet — will paste in #eng-oncall: ```1) Verify KV cache warm 2) Validate fallback to quantized-variant 3) Confirm region routing tables 4) Escalate plan if p99 > 400ms```

Ava Patel: Thanks all. Two final notes: (a) maintain signal on unit economics as we open GA (we cannot trade away margin without clear customer ROI), (b) smaller ask — execs please join the 10am PT EOD sync tomorrow for a 15m status readout. Appreciate the focus. :heart:
